title: Simple crop rotation and garden log
subcategory: Simple crop rotation and garden log
summary: Use records to avoid repeating the same crop family and the same mistakes.
steps: Draw a basic map and label each bed or container.
Record crop family, planting date, source, fertilisation, pest problems and harvest.
Where space allows, avoid planting the same crop family in the same soil every cycle.
Rotate with crops having different rooting and nutrient patterns; include soil-building cover where practical.
Keep rotation flexible when container mix is replaced or disease history requires a stricter response.
